summary: OBOOK Holdings Inc. (OwlTing Group, NASDAQ: OWLS), a Taiwan-based fintech, filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, reporting unaudited August 2026 operating metrics for its OwlPay Harbor platform. Annualized payment volume rose to approximately US$255 million, a 174.6% month-over-month increase, with contracted enterprise clients at 84. No special-situation corporate action is involved; the filing is a routine monthly operational update.
